purpose: Record two consequences NOW, while they are cheap to act on, rather than discovering them at P-4 or at write-up.
status: forward-looking record; neither item is a result

item_1_the_observed_band_is_later_and_na.measured_on: the positive control, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, by the official rank method with no kurtosis involved
item_1_the_observed_band_is_later_and_na.all_three_published_landmarks_present: near-zero early region, a rise, and a fall in the last layers
item_1_the_observed_band_is_later_and_na.the_discrepancy: the rise begins at roughly three quarters of depth (layer 20 of 27), not at about one third as the published description says

the_prior_in_our_own_method_memo.source: the depth-reindexed [38, 92] prior recorded in EQ1's OD-009
the_prior_in_our_own_method_memo.verdict: NOT consistent with what was measured on the positive control

why_this_is_recorded_now.consequence_if_the_shape_transfers_to_th: the P-4 candidate feature pool would shrink from roughly 130,000 to roughly 25,000
why_this_is_recorded_now.arithmetic: a 16-layer band versus a 3-layer band is a factor of about 5.3; the pool scales with the number of band layers
why_this_is_recorded_now.the_point: this is cheap to know now and expensive to discover at P-4
why_this_is_recorded_now.caveat: it is measured on the positive control, not on the target; whether the shape transfers is unknown and is not assumed here

item_2_absolute_readability_is_low.measurement: peak pooled pass@1 on the positive control is 0.0846
item_2_absolute_readability_is_low.meaning: at its best layer, the lens puts the labelled intermediate at rank 1 for about 8.5 percent of scored intermediates
item_2_absolute_readability_is_low.comparison: this is substantially weaker than the published report on a much larger frontier model
item_2_absolute_readability_is_low.how_it_must_be_reported: as a scale limitation, carried into the final limitations section
what_it_is_not: it is not evidence that the method is wrong
it is not evidence about J-space
it is not a statement about the target, which has not been measured
item_2_absolute_readability_is_low.an_honest_caveat_on_the_comparison: our figure and the published figure are not measured on the same items or the same models, so the comparison is indicative rather than a controlled contrast, and must be described that way

claim_ceiling: A forward-looking record. Neither item is a scientific finding, and neither licenses any claim about J-space.
